# Derived MIT code

Source: PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet 0.3.7 (npm baseline retained in compat/dsh-pet-0.3.7/manifest.json).
`player.js` retains the reviewed compositor-ready `switchPresentationVideo` method, with a small lifecycle wrapper and own namespace. It excludes the original host, model services, menus, art, prompts, fonts, and network polling. `work-status.js` (when present) is generated from the MIT work-status reducer. Company changes and feedback modules remain covered by CODE-LICENSE.md. Upstream copyright and full MIT terms are in LICENSE.
